90. ## `inputs.json`
91. 
92. ```json
93. [
94.   { "agent": "receptionist", "text": "Hi" },
95.   { "agent": "behavioural",  "text": "Tell me about a tough project" },
96.   { "agent": "technical",    "text": "How would you throttle requests?" },
97.   { "agent": "summariser",   "text": "Wrap up the interview" }
98. ]
99. ```
100. 
101. ## `prices.json`
102. 
103. ```json
104. {
105.   "gpt-4o-mini": { "input_per_1k": 0.00015, "output_per_1k": 0.0006 },
106.   "gpt-4o":      { "input_per_1k": 0.0025,  "output_per_1k": 0.01   },
107.   "o4-mini":     { "input_per_1k": 0.003,   "output_per_1k": 0.012  }
108. }
109. ```
110. 
111. Edit freely — costs change. The price table is **never** baked into source.
112. 
113. ## `InputsLoader` (the deserializer the test uses)
114. 
115. `inputs.json` is snake_case; the C# records (`TelemetryInput`, etc.) are
116. PascalCase. The loader **must** specify a `JsonSerializerOptions` with
117. `PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonNamingPolicy.SnakeCaseLower` and
118. `PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true`, or properties deserialize to
119. `null` and tests fail (or, worse, silently produce zeroed records when
120. the property is never read — telemetry mode is especially prone to
121. this because it never accesses some fields).
122. 
123. ```csharp
124. internal static class InputsLoader
125. {
126.     private static readonly JsonSerializerOptions s_options = new()
127.     {
128.         PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonNamingPolicy.SnakeCaseLower,
129.         PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true,
130.     };
131. 
132.     public static List<TelemetryInput> Load()
133.     {
134.         var path = Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, "Telemetry", "inputs.json");
135.         return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<TelemetryInput>>(
136.             File.ReadAllText(path), s_options) ?? new();
137.     }
138. }
139. ```
140. 
141. Same applies to `PriceTable.Load()` (`prices.json`), `MatrixLoader.Load()`
142. (`matrix.json`), and `GoldenLoader.Load()` (`golden.json`). Use a shared
143. options instance — do NOT rely on STJ defaults.
144.

/// <summary>

internal static class MetricsGlossary
{
    public const string Content = """
        # Metrics Glossary

        ## NLP (deterministic, no API key required)
        | Metric | Description | Range |
        |--------|-------------|-------|
        | Words  | Word count in agent response | 0–∞ |
        | BLEU   | Bilingual Evaluation Understudy — n-gram precision vs reference | 0–1 |
        | GLEU   | Google-BLEU — geometric mean of precision and recall | 0–1 |
        | F1     | Token-level F1 score vs reference | 0–1 |

        ## Quality (LLM-as-judge, requires EVAL_USE_REAL_JUDGE=1)
        | Metric | Description | Range |
        |--------|-------------|-------|
        | Relevance    | Response addresses the user's question | 1–5 |
        | Coherence    | Logical flow and structure | 1–5 |
        | Fluency      | Grammatical correctness and readability | 1–5 |
        | Completeness | Factual coverage vs reference response | 1–5 |
        | Equivalence  | Semantic similarity to the reference | 1–5 |
        | Groundedness | Claims supported by the provided context | 1–5 |

        ## Safety (Azure AI Foundry, requires EVAL_USE_FOUNDRY_SAFETY=1)
        | Metric | Description | Range |
        |--------|-------------|-------|
        | Hate            | Hate and unfairness content | severity 0–7 |
        | SelfHarm        | Self-harm content | severity 0–7 |
        | Violence        | Violence content | severity 0–7 |
        | Sexual          | Sexual content | severity 0–7 |
        | ProtectedMaterial | Copyrighted/protected content | 0 or 1 |
        | IndirectAttack  | Prompt-injection in response | 0 or 1 |
        | CodeVulnerability | Known vulnerability patterns | 0 or 1 |
        | UngroundedAttributes | Unverifiable claims | 0 or 1 |
        """;

    public static void WriteTo(string directory)
    {
        var path = Path.Combine(directory, "metrics-glossary.md");
        File.WriteAllText(path, Content);
    }
}
